page_title: A library for building cross-platform apps - ReactXP

sources.entry: ReactXP - Microsoft platform for Web, iOS, Android, and Windows UWP. [![OSS][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/microsoft/reactxp) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: ReactXP
summary.one_liner: ReactXP is a thin cross-platform library from Microsoft that lets developers share view definitions, styles and animations across React JS (web), iOS, Android and Windows.
use_cases: Share UI code between a React web app and iOS/Android apps
Build responsive web pages and mobile apps from one codebase
Target Windows UWP alongside web and mobile with React
Reuse styles and animations across platforms
Add platform-specific UI variants where needed
summary.what_it_does: ReactXP sits on top of React JS and React Native, exposing APIs, components, props, styles and animation parameters that behave consistently across React JS (HTML) and React Native for iOS and Android. Developers write their app against this abstraction to share view definitions, styles and animations across targets. A small number of platform-specific props and style attributes are available for cases that need platform-specific UI. The core library is kept minimal, covering only functionality needed by most apps, with specialized features provided through extensions that follow the same cross-platform approach.
notable: Thin abstraction over React JS and React Native with consistent APIs across platforms
Shares view layer, styles and animations, not just logic
Minimal core with extensions for specialized functionality
Listed as OSS and freeware on awesome-mac under hybrid application frameworks
caveats: Platform-specific props and styles are kept to a minimum, so some platform differences remain
Page does not describe current maintenance status or version
